title: IT / Finance / Security Ops Sync
summary: Weekly cross-functional sync between IT, Finance Ops, and Security to review VPC peering progress, SOC2/KMS documentation status, billing allocation issues, and upcoming procurement items. Decided on runbook updates, SSO test window, and a short pilot for billing tags. Agreed next steps and owners.
topics: Billing / chargeback tags and invoice cadence
Action item review and runbook updates
next_steps: Morgan to share SOC2 snapshot and KMS diagram by 2025-04-23 (link to internal doc)
Samir to update VPC peering runbook and post in #infra-docs by 2025-04-28
Priya to run a billing tag pilot for two teams and share results on 2025-05-05
Devon to schedule SSO/SAML test window with Legal and IT for 2025-04-25
Noah to kick off procurement task and confirm PO timeline by 2025-04-29

transcript:
Header:
Date: 2025-04-21
Start: 15:00 PT
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Morgan R., Kim A., Devon P., Samir G., Priya S., Liam O., Emma Z., Noah K., Jordan L.
Shared artifacts: internal doc - /docs/soc2-snapshot.pdf, runbook link - #infra-docs/vpc-peering.md, spreadsheet - cost-allocation-pilot.xlsx

[00:00] Morgan Reyes: okay, uh, thanks everyone for joining, we wanted to keep this tight, um 45 minutes ish, quick status across IT, finance ops, security and procurement. Samir you want to kick off VPC peering?
[00:20] Samir Gupta: yeah sure, thanks Morgan, so we've got three of five peering links in place, the outstanding ones are east-us to eu-west, we're waiting on network approvals and there was a small CIDR overlap with the analytics cluster which we're resolving. I also added the firewall rules in the draft runbook but, uh, note that the rule names in the cloud console got truncated so I put the exact rules in the doc.
[00:43] Kim Alvarez: quick q, are those peering links going to affect egress billing for cross-region traffic? we saw a spike last quarter that looked like cross-region replication.
[01:03] Samir Gupta: good point, yeah there could be egress, but the analytics cluster is mostly internal and we can pin replication windows, also we can route some backups over the private line to reduce egress. I'll add estimated cost delta to the runbook.
[01:21] Priya Shah: that would help, also for billing tags: our current invoice parsing misses a few resources because tags were inconsistent, so I want to pilot a stricter tag schema for infra and infra-data teams.
[01:40] Morgan Reyes: okay, Priya, that pilot sounds good. Kim, can you coordinate with Priya?
[01:47] Kim Alvarez: yeah I'll sync, we'll pick two teams and run the pilot for 2 billing cycles.
[01:55] Devon Park: on the security side, status of SOC2 evidence, Morgan? are we comfortable with the documentation we have for KMS and key rotation? I saw a diagram but it was missing some flow for on-prem HSM calls.
[02:14] Morgan Reyes: right, I uploaded a SOC2 snapshot, and a KMS diag — it's in the shared docs. The HSM flow was hand-wavy in the current draft, I'll follow up with the infra eng that owns the HSM proxy.
[02:29] Liam O'Connor: just flagging that Legal asked for key custody details and whether the KMS is customer-managed for Private deployments. Emma, do you have the note from legal?
[02:43] Emma Zhou: yeah legal's note says we should clarify the difference in our docs between customer-managed KMS (on-prem/private) vs Redwood-managed keys in hosted. They want explicit wording for contracts.
[02:57] Morgan Reyes: noted. I'll add a section to the KMS doc for contract wording and hand over to Legal for sign-off.
[03:06] Noah Kim: procurement question — for the Dedicated pilot procurement, what docs do you need from us? PO, SOW, or just a short purchase memo?
[03:19] Morgan Reyes: for initial reserved capacity pilot we'd like a PO and a basic SOW, plus expected usage profile. Priya, can you prepare the cost profile?
[03:30] Priya Shah: yes, I'll do that, but I need the model sizing; Jordan can you confirm expected GPUs and expected hours?
[03:39] Jordan Lee: right now it's an estimate — 8 A100-equivalents for 3 months as a pilot, we'll refine once the load test runs.
[03:49] Samir Gupta: on the networking, also we should set a maintenance window for the peering change to avoid DB hiccups. propose Saturday 23:00 PT?
[04:01] Devon Park: that's fine by security as long as we run the SSO test before and rollback plan is documented.
[04:10] Morgan Reyes: speaking of SSO, Devon you're owning the SSO/SAML test with Legal and IT?
[04:16] Devon Park: yep, scheduling for Friday morning, but we may need to move it to Monday depending on Legal availability. will confirm.
[04:25] Emma Zhou: I can be there Friday but, uh, need the test plan in advance.
[04:31] Devon Park: sure I'll send the test matrix and expected outcomes.
[04:36] Morgan Reyes: any open security findings we need to call out?
[04:40] Liam O'Connor: just two low-medium items — missing audit log retention settings for some Lambdas and an RBAC role that was too broad. I opened tickets.
[04:52] Morgan Reyes: okay we'll prioritize the RBAC ticket, Samir to help with the infra side.
[04:58] Samir Gupta: yes I'll take that.
[05:00] Priya Shah: back to billing — can someone share the cost allocation spreadsheet link now?
[05:06] Morgan Reyes: yes it's in the agenda, cost-allocation-pilot.xlsx in the shared drive. Priya, please run the first pass.
[05:13] Kim Alvarez: also a quick note: we got a vendor invoice question from Legal, they asked for an itemized breakout for Q1, Noah?
[05:23] Noah Kim: i'll get the PO and itemized lines, should be able to share by next week.
[05:28] Morgan Reyes: great. recapping next steps: Morgan shares SOC2 + KMS diagram; Samir updates runbook; Priya pilot tags; Devon runs SSO test; Noah follows procurement. Anything else?
[05:46] Priya Shah: can we add a short weekly update to the infra channel after the pilot starts? keeps finance in the loop.
[05:52] Kim Alvarez: agreed.
[05:54] Morgan Reyes: ok last thing — timeline: try to have the major items wrapped within two weeks, procurement by end of next week. we'll re-check at the same time next week. Thanks all.
[06:08] Emma Zhou: thanks everyone.
[06:12] Meeting ends
